intent: Crack the mirror along the divider while keeping tools on their respective sides. The resemblance remains useful precisely because the rooms do not merge.
source:
**Frame:** The mirror cracks along the split rather than joining the rooms. Similar tools remain on opposite sides.

> THE OBSERVER NEEDS TOOLS THAT RESEMBLE THE OBSERVED.
>
> RESEMBLANCE DOES NOT ERASE DIFFERENCE.

title: The mirror does not join the two rooms
